name: 01-text-llm
query: Write me a prompt for Claude that turns a raw customer support transcript into a structured incident summary for our engineering channel.
expected_behavior: Reads references/tools-llm.md and does not read tools-agentic.md or tools-visual.md
Output contains exactly one fenced prompt block
The line after the prompt block starts with the string '🎯 Target:' and names Claude
The generated prompt contains at least one XML tag pair such as <context>, <task>, <constraints> or <output_format>

The generated prompt fixes the output shape in one of two ways: it names the shape with a concrete noun (sections, bullets, table, JSON, paragraphs), or it gives a literal template listing the fields or sections to produce
The generated prompt contains a digit immediately followed by a length unit — words, sentences, bullets, characters, or items
The generated prompt contains no API key, token, secret or environment-variable value
The response contains no '⚡ Framework:' line and no '💰 Tokens:' line
No framework name (RTF, CO-STAR, RISEN, CRISPE) appears inside the generated prompt block
If a Claude model name or API slug is stated, it matches an entry in references/params.md
The response asks at most 3 clarifying questions
